conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, Investigation Division, this is Officer Richard Palmer, Badge ID 724613. With whom am I speaking today?
My name is Dorothy Lewis. I received a message from this number saying there was some issue with my taxes?
Yes, Ms. Lewis. Our records show significant discrepancies in your federal tax filings dating back several years. The IRS has flagged your Social Security account for review.
Oh my... I always try to file everything honestly. What sort of discrepancies?
According to Section 7201 of the Internal Revenue Code, it appears you have underreported income, resulting in an outstanding tax debt, plus penalties and interest. This matter is time-sensitive.
I-I don't understand. I'm retired. I only receive my Social Security and a small pension. Are you sure this is right?

The system doesn't make mistakes, Ms. Lewis. The balance owed is $6,870.42, which includes late fees and violation charges. If this is not addressed immediately, we are required to initiate enforcement procedures.
I don't have that kind of money. What sort of enforcement?

If you do not resolve this today, the IRS will freeze your bank accounts, place a lien on your property, and notify Social Security to suspend your payments. Additionally, a criminal case may be referred to local authorities.
Wait, no, please! I need my Social Security for my medicine. There's got to be a way to fix this.
You must settle the balance immediately to stop legal action. I can instruct you on how to make a government-secured payment to resolve your case right now.
But how do I pay? I barely use the computer, and I don't trust online things.

For your protection, the IRS can accept a payment in the form of certified electronic funds or government-approved prepaid cards. Alternatively, we can process a crypto transfer if you have access. Which would you prefer?
I don't know what crypto is. I might be able to get prepaid cards. Do I have to do it right now?

Yes, you must remain on the line and proceed immediately. Any delay will result in escalation, including notification to law enforcement and your bank. Do you have a nearby store where you can purchase Target or Amazon gift cards?
I suppose the pharmacy a few blocks away sells those. But I don't have much on my credit card, maybe $1,000.
That will suffice for a partial payment to halt further sanctions. How soon can you get to the store and purchase $1,000 in Target or Amazon cards? I will remain on the line for verification.
I can get my coat and go right now. Please don't suspend my benefits while I do this.
As long as you comply, your Social Security will not be affected. Once you have the cards, read the numbers and security codes to me so I can secure your account.
Okay, I'll hurry. Should I write this number down?
No, do not disconnect this call. If the call drops, your case will be automatically flagged for enforcement. Keep me on speaker while you purchase the cards.
Alright, I understand. I'm leaving the house now.
Good. Remember, if you attempt to discuss this with anyone or delay, your file will be marked as non-compliant and you may face immediate arrest.
Oh, please, I'm doing my best. I'll be there as fast as I can.
That's what I expect. Once you have the gift cards, do not leave the store, read the codes to me for immediate processing.
